trades.thesis: Q3 beat: revenue $2.25B +17% ($40M above forecast), non-GAAP EPS 4.36 vs about 3.94 expected, operating margin 10.8% vs 9.7%, record $33B backlog (74% non-Israel, Europe-led, recent NATO PULS orders), FCF $276M, 2027 guide of high-teens revenue growth plus margin expansion. Stock had slid four sessions and sits 33% below its high; low beta to US tech selloff. Risks: Middle East flare-ups, gap fade, rich multiple.
